meta.title: Thanh Hoa — Travel & Culture of the Thanh Land
meta.description: Discover the nature, cuisine and culture of Thanh Hoa: Pu Luong, Sam Son, the Ho Dynasty Citadel, Ben En National Park and many more destinations.

footer.about: A guide to the nature, cuisine and culture of Thanh Hoa — a land of rich heritage in Vietnam's North Central Coast.
footer.address: Thanh Hoa City, Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam

hero.title: Discover Thanh Hoa
hero.subtitle: From the mountains of Pu Luong to the beaches of Sam Son, from the Ho Dynasty Citadel to the rich flavours of local cuisine.

featured.title: Destinations not to be missed
featured.subtitle: Signature places, flavours and heritage to start your journey.

why.title: Mountains, sea, heritage and flavour in one journey

nature.title: Varied nature
nature.text: From the western mountains with rice terraces and lakes to the long eastern coastline, every season brings a different Thanh Hoa.

heritage.title: Heritage and history
heritage.text: The Ho Dynasty Citadel, Lam Kinh, Đông Sơn culture and Hàm Rồng tell important chapters of the nation's story.

food.title: Rich local flavours
food.text: Nem chua, Tứ Trụ gai leaf cake and sea-fresh seafood define the taste of Thanh Hoa.

cta.title: Ready to plan your trip?
cta.text: See the destinations on the map, or ask KAT, our virtual assistant, for itinerary ideas.

tourism.title: Travel
tourism.subtitle: From the mountains of Pu Luong and the beaches of Sam Son to Ben En National Park — destinations not to be missed.

cuisine.title: Cuisine
cuisine.subtitle: Fermented pork rolls, Tu Tru gai leaf cakes and the specialties that give Thanh Hoa its own flavour.

culture.title: Culture
culture.subtitle: The Ho Dynasty Citadel, Dong Son culture, Lam Kinh — the historical depth and identity of Thanh Hoa.
